notes: Identity assessment: supplied cache identifies SOURCE_URL as the BCU-hosted BLOOMFIELD_JUANITA_2019_6310.pdf and VERSION as author working paper. Its title is “Using behavioral insights in early childhood interventions: The effects of Crianza Positiva text and voice messaging program on parenting behavior and competences”, by Juanita Bloomfield, Ana Balsa and Alejandro Cid, August 2019. Authors, intervention and RCT identity agree with the neutral original reference, but this is an earlier primary working-paper version, not the cited 2022/2023 journal version; exact published-version equivalence is unverified. The supplied working-paper p. 20 describes messaging compliance and starts evaluation scales, rather than containing the requested effects. No PDF was supplied; no rendering or acquisition was performed. The outcome label is identifiable, but the neutral description does not distinguish frequency from every-day involvement or select an unadjusted/controlled specification and inference method. The journal p. 20 locator cannot be transferred to this earlier working paper. No unique target test is established. Table 5 gives descriptive follow-up outcome N=318, not an explicitly identified critical-model analytic N. Table 6a supplies several specifications without a model N; the source discusses outcome-specific missingness and covariate imputation. Retain this descriptive N only as a candidate; no N is derived or promoted while the target model/version remains unresolved. Printed candidates (not selected estimates): Table 6a row: Social Activities                                                                                           0.169         0.077             0.102             0.085            0.183*           0.229**            0.164*             0.851               0.756; Table A2 row: Social Activities every day            0.067**          0.050          0.025          0.042          0.068**        0.073**         0.050*          0.245   0.632. Table 6a/A2 column (1) is the unstandardized ITT outcome-difference coefficient; columns (2), (3), (4) respectively give clustering-adjusted, MHT-adjusted, and randomization-inference p-values for that column (1) coefficient. Columns (5)–(7) give different controlled specifications; their stars supply only bounds per the printed legend (* p<0.1; **p<0.05; ***p<0.01), not the exact p-values in columns (2)–(4). No metric conversion or p-value computation performed. Unassigned replication and reported-success records are placeholders only.
